statements.t: Dewan concluded, “Building on the growth we delivered in Systems Integration in the third quarter and current visibility into our pipeline, we anticipate further growth in the fourth quarter.
We are raising our 2026 outlook for Adjusted EBITDA to a range of $21 million to $23 million.”

The Company has not provided a reconciliation of its Adjusted EBITDA outlook to net income, the most directly comparable GAAP measure, for the reasons described under “About Non-GAAP Financial Measures” below.
